name: @velaros-ai/path-rules
description: Path rules shared by capability spaces: glob matching with directory-prefix semantics, .gitignore parsing and evaluation (negation, anchoring, directory-only, character classes), traversal ignore policy backed by git itself when available, and the directory names traversal skips by default.
author: VelarOS

scripts.build: bun run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/capabilities/build/fix-esm-extensions.mjs dist && node ../../scripts/build/normalize-package-declarations.mjs
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test spec/acceptance.test.ts test/path-matcher.test.ts test/gitignore-rules.test.ts test/ignore-policy.test.ts
